name: Custom Shape 2-Layer White And Mirror Acrylic Ornament
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from 2 layers of 3mm acrylic, combining White Acrylic and Mirror Acrylic to create a dimensional, premium ornament.
    - Available in 2 construction styles:
             +) Style 1: Layer 1 – 3mm White Acrylic with 1-sided printing; Layer 2 – 3mm Mirror Acrylic with engraving or custom cutout.
             +) Style 2: Layer 1 – 3mm Mirror Acrylic with engraving or custom cutout; Layer 2 – 3mm White Acrylic with 1-sided printing.
    - Mirror Acrylic is available in:
             +) Gold Mirror Acrylic
             +) Silver Mirror Acrylic
    - Custom-cut construction allows different silhouettes, frames, lettering, and decorative elements to be incorporated into the design.
    - Comes with included hanging accessories for easy display.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in sizes:
             +) 3.54 x 3.54 in ~ 9 x 9 cm
             +) 4 x 4 in ~ 10.16 x 10.16 cm
             +) 5 x 5 in ~ 12.7 x 12.7 cm
             +) 6 x 6 in ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - White Acrylic layer features high-quality 1-sided UV printing for vibrant colors, photos, names, messages, and detailed artwork.
    - Mirror Acrylic layer supports precision laser engraving and laser cutting for personalized wording, decorative frames, lettering, and custom shapes.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a personalized hanging ornament for Christmas trees, home décor, room decoration, memorial displays, and seasonal decoration.
    - Suitable for customization with names, family members, photos, dates, meaningful messages, and decorative cutout elements.
    - Two-layer construction adds dimension and allows printed artwork to be combined with reflective engraved or cutout details.
    - Lightweight and durable for convenient hanging and long-lasting decorative use.
    - Easy to display with the included hanging accessories.
    - Suitable for Christmas-themed, family, memorial, baby, couple, and personalized keepsake designs.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, couples, grandparents, parents, children, friends, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Christmas, Baby’s First Christmas, family celebrations, memorial keepsakes, anniversaries, and other special occasions.
    - Ideal for remembering loved ones with personalized names, dates, messages, or memorial designs.
    - Great for creating unique family ornaments featuring custom photos and individual names.
    - A beautiful keepsake that combines personalized printing with elegant Gold or Silver Mirror Acrylic details.

  • Processing Time: 1-3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6-9 working days average (US)
  • Packaging:1 x Custom Shape 2-Layer White And Mirror Acrylic Ornament

  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
